name: Childhood photo to family gym montage
description: Five hard-cut crops of one childhood sibling photo reveal into twelve independently recorded adult gym formations with the same fictional family identity lineage.
lockedGrammar: One fictional sibling group remains recognizable from childhood through adulthood
Five editorial crops of one childhood photograph fill the opening five seconds
Twelve independently generated adult gym takes follow in source-timed order
Every transition is a zero-duration hard cut with no dissolves or generated morphs
Adult formations alternate frontal, profile, stacked-arm, fan-arm, seated and low-angle lineups
Dark high-contrast directional gym lighting remains coherent across adult takes
The opening hook is deterministic and audio is applied only during finishing

variables.description: A fully fictional or authorized sibling group used consistently as children and adults.
variables.defaultValue: five clearly fictional siblings with stable distinct faces, hair colors, builds and plausible family resemblance
examples: three sisters and two brothers with mixed hair colors

variables.description: The number and gender presentation of siblings maintained through the entire format.
variables.defaultValue: exactly one adult woman and four adult men

variables.description: Simple coordinated clothes for the childhood photograph.
variables.defaultValue: simple dark sleeveless tops with one light top and loose colored trousers

variables.description: Coherent adult workout wardrobe across the twelve takes.
variables.defaultValue: dark sleeveless gymwear with burgundy and blue trousers, ending in loose hoodies
a dark commercial gym with mirrors, dumbbells, a lifting platform and hard overhead spotlights
pov: the whole family locked in
examples: pov: the whole family locked in on GymLevels

variables.description: Authorized source audio or a replacement beat aligned to all hard cuts.
variables.defaultValue: new royalty-cleared beat with accents at every photo and adult-take cut

notes: Revision 2 links to validator-accepted Fidelity Map fm-childhood-to-family-gym-montage-v2 (fixtures/fidelity-maps/fm-childhood-to-family-gym-montage-v2.json), combining deterministic cut boundaries with three source-only Gemini 3.8 Agentic choreography passes.

The earlier map compressed twelve distinct adult actions into one generic posing label; revision 2 preserves each take's observed start, ordered movement, endpoint, visible subject count and camera state.
Validated through 14 setup images, twelve independent five-second motion generations, exact source frame-count finishing and zero automatic retries.
Manual full-timeline review confirmed stable fictional sibling identities, source-specific subject counts, hard cuts, formation variety and dark directional lighting.
The childhood image is generated once and reframed deterministically; all adult takes use separate setup and motion units.
The recipe transfers structure only; identities, childhood photos, audio, settings, logos and permissions never carry into a new instantiation.
